Find connected threshold-exceeding clusters on arbitrary coordinates

Source: R/find_clusters_nd.R
find_clusters_nd.Rd

Find connected threshold-exceeding clusters on arbitrary coordinates

Usage

find_clusters_nd(
  data,
  coordinates = "time",
  value = "value",
  threshold = 10,
  threshold_type = c("both", "above", "below"),
  group = NULL,
  sensor_id = NULL,
  sensor_adjacency = NULL,
  max_gap = NULL
)

Arguments

data

Data frame containing unique coordinate combinations and a statistic.

coordinates

Character vector of regular-grid coordinate names. For sensor-time data, normally `"time"` (sensor topology is separate).

value

Column containing positive posterior odds (default `"value"`).

threshold

Posterior-odds threshold, strictly greater than one.

threshold_type

`"both"`, `"above"`, or `"below"`.

group

Optional grouping column; connected components never cross groups.

sensor_id

Optional column with sensor identifiers.

sensor_adjacency

Named logical/numeric matrix with sensor row/column names, or two-column data frame with sensor pairs.

max_gap

Optional named list of maximum allowed differences for numeric grid coordinates (e.g. `list(time = 0.004)`). By default adjacent observed coordinate levels connect, even when physically far apart.

Value

List with `clusters` (one row per component), `membership` (one row per threshold-exceeding sample), and `edges` (full-domain graph edges).
